runtimeMapping.bornSequence: S1 castOnLocate maps to deployment-time modifier attachment with the original one-second born visual/protection. S2/S3 event-gated 1Frame maps to one local tick; the following native cooldown1 gates duration-buff entry.
runtimeMapping.initialBurst: S2 native .1666699946 preDelay with START ground-only selection and RES multiplier before damage; S3 .6000000238 preDelay, CAST selection, retained victims, second hit after .200000003 seconds.
runtimeMapping.ordinaryAttacks: Original Attack .367; S2 first event .267 then native .1000000015 delta at the prepared capped animation rate; S3 original .367 event. Retained ground victim and transient-control/deployment/activation checks.
runtimeMapping.drizzle: Native independent-source EXTEND retains fixed damage and tick phase, silence and target-owned DoT survive finite skill end or source retirement.
runtimeMapping.rain: Native firstTriggerInterval .400000006 then selected interval1. Distinct all-motion targets; emitted unowned impact uses random0..300000012 plus lifeTime .1000000015, retained victim and current source ATK.
runtimeMapping.talents: Selected active ATK percentages add to skill ATK; first confirmed credited enemy removal schedules one .03-second reset after the cast phase and abnormal states. Heal honors heal-free while skipping modifier events. T2 ASPD and unfiltered nonstackable HP damage resistance finish on first confirmed kill.
runtimeMapping.hud: Finite passive effects show their selected duration, stay full through the adapter born sequence, and hide inactive gauges/ready actions.

verificationLimits: The compiled native Sequence/FSM callback phases are not executable in this browser adapter. One-frame handoff, cooldown-to-buff attachment, S1 eventless castOnLocate and pending-reset legality are explicit local interpretations; frame parity is false.

Native target-selector callback ordering, animation rate rebasing, projectile random-distribution/RNG consumption and delayed-damage attribution after a source retires/redeploys require executable game comparison.
Native triggerability flag bypass is mapped to rain continuing under control/disarm; burst interruption and buff-duration phase boundaries require game comparison.
Exact native particles, audio and modules are not implemented by this adapter. Original chibi clips and existing damage presentation are used.
Coverage counts a source-based playable kit, not independently certified native game fidelity. Only 0-1 and the two existing basic enemy types are enabled.
